title: Jon Hamm Returns to Screens in Series About 70s Hostage Crisis
seoTitle: Jon Hamm Stars in New 70s Hostage Drama 'American Hostage'
subtitle: The new Prime Video production features the actor as a journalist in a real 1977 case
excerpt: Jon Hamm stars as journalist Fred Heckman in 'American Hostage,' a series that reconstructs the 1977 kidnapping, with new episodes released weekly on Sundays.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Jon Hamm is back in the spotlight following the premiere of the series "American Hostage" on Prime Video. The actor plays journalist Fred Heckman, who covered the 1977 kidnapping of Dick Hall live, and has been captivating audiences in recent weeks.

What is "American Hostage"?

"American Hostage" is a series based on true events, recounting the 63-hour hostage-taking of Dick Hall by Tony Kiritsis. The plot follows the unfolding situation through Kiritsis' calls to local radio station WIBC and his press conferences.

Jon Hamm as Fred Heckman

In the production, Jon Hamm portrays journalist Fred Heckman, who received calls from Kiritsis during the standoff. The series releases two episodes every Sunday, allowing the audience to follow the story's progression on a weekly basis.

Recreating the Era

To faithfully reproduce the 1977 environment, the production team sourced radio equipment from the decade, including a set found in Winnipeg that was restored to function during filming. This meticulous attention to detail allowed Hamm's lines to be broadcast as if live.

Cultural Context of the Case

The kidnapping occurred amidst an economic recession, creating an atmosphere of tension and curiosity that was reflected in press coverage. The series highlights the contrast between the figure of Kiritsis, seen by some as a symbol of rebellion, and Dick Hall, represented as part of the traditional establishment.

Series Availability

Episodes of "American Hostage" are streamed on Sundays on Prime Video, with the first two already available. The production has garnered discussion among viewers, highlighting Hamm's performance and the period setting.
